bg.purpose: The page ground panels sit on.

panel.purpose: Surface of every bordered region; also the text colour on inverted elements.

panel-2.purpose: Inset areas that recede: input interiors, header strips, chips, edit rows.

line.purpose: The 1px border on every panel, field, chip and divider. The system's primary separator.

line-soft.purpose: Row dividers inside lists, and the empty track behind every progress bar.

ink.purpose: Primary text and figures; also the background of inverted elements.

ink-dim.purpose: Section headings, secondary figures, ghost button text.

ink-faint.purpose: The annotation layer: labels, units, counts, placeholders. Must clear 4.5:1 on bg, panel and panel-2 at 11px; the earlier #8891a0 / #5b6473 pair measured 3.18/2.97/2.74 light and 3.07/2.90/3.28 dark and failed everywhere.

accent.purpose: The only accent. In-range progress fill, active nav tab, input focus border, inline creating actions.

ok.purpose: Used only for the calorie readout's remaining-headroom figure. A state report, never a reward.

warn.purpose: Declared alongside the accent and currently identical to it in light. Reserved; no component consumes it today.

over.purpose: Past-target figures and fills, and destructive affordances on hover.

grid.purpose: The 16px two-axis measurement grid behind the calorie readout, and nowhere else.

display.purpose: The day's calorie total, and nothing else. The single largest object on screen.

headline.purpose: Tab titles. A location marker, not a banner — deliberately only 0.875rem.

body.purpose: Food names, input values, prose. The only size real sentences are set at.

label.purpose: The annotation layer: metric names, units, counts, hints. Uniform everywhere.

data.purpose: Inline measured values. Mono + tabular; the .num class. Never used for prose.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Toasts only. The sole shadow in the application; permitted because a toast overlays page content.

shadows.name: overlay-veil
shadows.value: backdrop-filter: blur(16px); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 88%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: The fixed bottom navigation, so content scrolling beneath stays perceptible without competing.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Every hover, focus and active colour change. The system's default and most common transition.

motion.name: fill
motion.purpose: Progress bar width on meters and the calorie bar. Slow enough to be read as a value settling.

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: Toast entry. The only keyframe animation in the system.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: The delete affordance on an entry row, hidden until hover or focus.

breakpoints.name: column-max
breakpoints.purpose: The single content column's maximum width (max-w-2xl). The system has no other breakpoint.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The concluding action of a form. Inverted ink block, uppercase micro-label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink); color: var(--panel); border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary and paired actions. Hairline border, dim text that firms up on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink-dim); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Every text and numeric input. Sunken interior, hairline border, amber border on focus — no ring.
components.css: .ds-field { background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 8px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-field:focus { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-num { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-align: right; }

components.name: Meter
components.description: The signature component. Label and value/goal above a 4px track with an amber fill; the fill and figure turn red past goal.
components.html: Protein96/150g
components.css: .ds-meter { min-width: 140px; } .ds-meter-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-meter-label { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; line-height: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-meter-val { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-dim); } .ds-meter-val b { font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); } .ds-meter-unit { color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-meter-track { margin-top: 4px; width: 100%; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--line-soft); } .ds-meter-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--accent); transition: width 500ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-meter-fill.is-over { background: var(--over); }

components.css: .ds-readout { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px; background-image: linear-gradient(to right, var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 16px 16px; } .ds-readout-top { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-readout-label { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-readout-count { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-readout-figures { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; margin-top: 4px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-readout-total { font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: var(--ink); } .ds-readout-goal { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-readout-left { margin-left: auto; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ok); } .ds-readout-left.is-over { color: var(--over); } .ds-readout-state { margin-left: 4px; font-size: 0.6875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-readout-track { margin-top: 8px; width: 100%; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--line-soft); } .ds-readout-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--accent); transition: width 500ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1); }

components.name: Collapsible Panel
components.description: Bordered region with an uppercase header, optional faint hint, and a monospace +/− as the only disclosure indicator.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 12px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-panel-title { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--ink-dim); } .ds-panel-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-panel-hint { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-panel-glyph { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-panel-body { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 10px 12px; }

components.name: Week Strip
components.description: Seven cells sharing vertical hairlines. The selected day inverts to an ink block — the same inversion the primary button uses.
components.css: .ds-week { display: flex; overflow: hidden; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-day { flex: 1; border: none; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--ink-dim); padding: 6px 0; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-day:last-child { border-right: none; } .ds-day.is-active { background: var(--ink); color: var(--panel); } .ds-day-w { display: block; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-day-n { display: block; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Quick-Add Chips
components.description: Horizontally scrolling one-tap log targets. Favourites carry amber text and a star; recents are plain ink.
components.html: ★ Oatmeal 320Greek yogurt 140Chicken breast 330
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 4px; scrollbar-width: none; } .ds-chips::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; } .ds-chip { flex-shrink: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-chip b { font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-chip-fav { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 500; } .ds-chip-fav b { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 400; }

components.name: Entry Row
components.description: One logged food. Sans name on the left, mono macro triplet and calories right-aligned, delete revealed on hover.

  • Oatmeal12/54/6320✕
components.css: .ds-rows { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft); } .ds-row:first-child { border-top: none; } .ds-row-name { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-name { color: var(--accent); } .ds-row-name i { font-style: normal; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-row-macros { flex-shrink: 0; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-row-cal { flex-shrink: 0; width: 56px; text-align: right; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); } .ds-row-del { flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--ink-faint); opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-del { opacity: 1; } .ds-row-del:hover { color: var(--over); }

components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); animation: ds-toast-in 0.25s ease; } .ds-toast-success { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; } .ds-toast-error { background: var(--over); color: #fff; } .ds-toast-info { background: var(--ink); color: var(--panel); } @keyframes ds-toast-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

narrative.overview:
This is an app that reports. It does not congratulate, encourage, or celebrate. A day of eating is a set of measured quantities against a set of targets, and the interface's whole job is to put those quantities in front of a competent daily user as fast and as densely as a phone screen allows. Everything reads on a grid: hairline-divided cells, right-aligned figures in tabular monospace, uppercase labels at the smallest legible size, and a near-monochrome field carrying exactly one signal colour. Density is the virtue. Whitespace is not added to seem friendly.

The palette is a full light/dark pair defined wholesale in app/globals.css — every token has two values and nothing is theme-conditional beyond those definitions. Dark is the app's home ground (it is the PWA's declared theme_color), and light is the same instrument under daylight rather than a different design. Surfaces are flat: separation comes from a 1px rule and a half-step of tonal shift, never from a shadow. Corners are barely rounded — 4px is the house radius, enough to avoid looking broken, too little to read as soft.

The single amber accent is a signal, not warmth. It marks progress inside a goal and the few pieces of text that act on something. It is not there to make the app feel friendly, and it must never be spent on decoration; when a number goes over its target the fill turns red and the amber's absence is the message. The system is deliberately unfashionable — no gradients, no glass, no glow, no illustration — because it is meant to look the same in five years as it does today.
keyCharacteristics: Monospace tabular numerals for every measured quantity; system sans for everything else
1px hairline borders and tonal panel layering as the only separation devices
One amber signal colour, with green and red reserved strictly for goal state
11px uppercase 0.05em labels as the universal annotation voice
Flat by default; shadow permitted only on elements that overlay the page
A 672px maximum column, tuned for one-handed portrait use with a fixed bottom nav

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber means "measured progress, still in range" or "this text performs an action". It is never a background for a large area, never a decorative highlight, never applied to a heading, and never used to make something look important. If a screen has more than a few percent amber on it, the rule is broken.

rules.name: The Three-State Number Rule
rules.body: A figure is neutral ink by default, green only when it reports remaining headroom, and red only when it has passed its target. There is no fourth colour for numbers, and no colour that means "good job".

rules.name: The Two-Value Rule
rules.body: Every colour is defined once in :root and once in .dark, both in app/globals.css. No component may hardcode a hex, and no component may branch on theme — if a value needs to differ between themes, it becomes a token.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Monospace and tabular figures are reserved for quantities that were measured or recorded. Prose never takes mono, and a number never takes sans. This split is what makes the numerals mean something — if everything were mono, nothing would read as data. Apply it with the .num class, never with an ad-hoc font-family.

rules.name: The Small Caps Rule
rules.body: Every label in the system is the same object: 0.6875rem, uppercase, 0.05em tracking, faint ink. Labels do not vary in size, weight, or colour between panels. Their uniformity is what lets the eye skip them and land on the figures.

rules.name: The No Column Rule
rules.body: Right-aligned figures with tabular numerals do the aligning; the system never adds a border, a background, or extra tracking to make a column line up.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one content column at every viewport. Extra horizontal space becomes margin, never a second column or a sidebar. Anything that needs horizontal room scrolls inside its own row (.no-scrollbar), as the favourite and recent chips already do.

rules.name: The Reachable Nav Rule
rules.body: Primary navigation stays fixed at the bottom within thumb reach, and no primary action may live in a top bar.

rules.name: The Float-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadow and blur are permitted only on elements that overlay page content. Anything in the document flow — panels, cards, rows, inputs, chips, buttons — is flat, at rest and on hover, without exception.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: One pixel, --line, is the system's separator. Do not reach for a thicker border, a coloured border, a double rule, or a shadow to separate two regions.

rules.name: The Nothing-Is-Round Rule
rules.body: No pills, no circles, no fully-rounded controls. Segmented controls and toggles are square-cornered like everything else.

dos: Do put every colour in app/globals.css as a token with both a :root and a .dark value, and consume it via the Tailwind alias (text-ink-faint) or var(--token).
Do apply .num to every measured quantity, and right-align it. A figure that is not tabular monospace is a bug.
Do set labels at 0.6875rem uppercase with 0.05em tracking in --ink-faint, always.
Do separate regions with a single 1px --line border and, where a region should recede, a shift to --panel-2.
Do keep the accent for in-range progress, the active nav tab, focus borders, and inline creating actions — and nothing else.
Do let a progress fill turn --over red the moment its value passes its goal, in both the meter and the calorie bar.
Do collapse anything optional behind a Panel with a + / − glyph, so the day's figures stay above it.
Do keep new panels at 12px padding and 8px separation; match the existing rhythm rather than introducing a larger step.
donts: Don't hardcode a hex value in a component. components/MiniChart.tsx currently defaults to emerald #10b981 and components/TrendsCard.tsx passes indigo #6366f1 — both are outside the palette and are drift to be corrected. Charts take --accent, with --ink-dim and --ink-faint for additional series; the system has one signal colour and data visualisation is not an exemption.

Don't use round or pill shapes. components/ThemeToggle.tsx currently renders rounded-full pills with emoji; it is drift on both counts — a segmented control here is square-cornered with stroked SVG glyphs, and no emoji appears anywhere in the interface.

Don't use the older auth-screen language. components/AuthForm.tsx still uses rounded-lg inputs with an amber focus ring, a 1.5rem heading, and bespoke padding; the field, button, and type scale defined here are the system, and the login screen is not exempt.
Don't add a shadow to anything that sits in the document flow, including on hover.
Don't introduce a webfont, an icon package, or any CDN-hosted asset. The app ships self-contained.
Don't add gradients, glass or translucency (outside the nav's existing veil), glow, illustration, or decorative imagery. The system is intentionally unfashionable.
Don't use green or red for anything except goal state and destructive intent. Neither colour may be used to praise, congratulate, or mark a streak.
Don't widen past the 672px column or add a second column, sidebar, or top navigation bar on any surface.
Don't set prose in monospace or figures in sans. The split is the system's primary semantic signal.
